 It's been a career-best year for Tiafoe - only Alexander Zverev and Daniil Medvedev have won more than the American's 44 matches in 2026. 
 Tiafoe has improved his consistency, which is evident through his amazing 19-1 record in opening matches for the season. 
 The 28-year-old had a huge summer at home, finishing runner-up at the Cincinnati Masters before advancing to the US Open semi-finals, propelling him into the top 10 and a strong chance to qualify for the ATP Finals for the first time. 
 Tiafoe needs a big indoor swing after going 2-2 in Asia. He made the Vienna semi-finals back in 2021. Lorenzo Musetti Form Analysis
 ATP 2026 Record: 25-12
 ATP Vienna Record: 5-4
 Current Ranking: No. 26
 Career-High Ranking: No. 5 (Jan 2026)
 Injury has disrupted Musetti's 2026 campaign and contributed to a fall outside the top 20. 
 The Italian was on fire to start the season and was about to beat Novak Djokovic in the Australian Open quarter-finals before he was forced to retire. 
 It's been a slow comeback, but Musetti is back to some of his best tennis, producing some stellar performances to beat the likes of Flavio Cobolli and Taylor Fritz to secure the Lyon silverware last week - just his third ATP title and first since 2022.
